The company develops and manufactures its products, and the company and its consolidated subsidiary Efu Esu Co., Ltd. sell them. Efu Esu Co., Ltd. also provides support and maintenance for systems for gaming halls and others. Mamiya IT Solutions Co., Ltd., a consolidated subsidiary, conducts general operations related to system development.
